results.q: What are the different kinds of Interviews I need to do with the research participants?
results.a:
Interview for recruiting research participants 

Regular interview to gather feedback from the participants regarding the program 

Interview with inactive participants to for problem mapping and troubleshooting 

Interview regarding the impact of using Circles for participants and their family

results.q: How often do I need to interview the research participants?
results.a:
(how long?) Interview for recruiting research participants 

Minimum 1 time every 2 weeks mandatory visit to all vendors and at least 10 users for:  
• Regular interview to gather feedback from the participants regarding the program 
• Interview with innactive participants to for problem mapping and troubleshooting 

(When, how many interview per users) Interview regarding the impact of using Circles for participants and their family

results.q: What do I do if I am confused while interviewing a research participant?
results.a:
Check the material given to you during the training program 

If needed, reach out to the research team for support and guidance 

If not possible, document what it is that confuses you in a single doc and share it with the Circles Bali team to be discussed promptly 

If it's related to questions from the users and the research team is not available to give support and guidance, document the questions in a single doc share it with the research team to be discussed promptly

results.q: What is the Circles Team Code of Conduct?
results.a:
No gratification - may not ask for anything from Research Participants  

Answers entered in the form must match the facts submitted by Research Participants

If you are confused about answering questions from Research Participants, contact the outreach team for support and advice 

No inappropriate content related to ethnicity, religion, race, and inter-group in MSC 

Respectful & Professional 

Represent Circles properly according to the information received during training 

Sharing Research Participants personal data to third parties is prohibited

results.q: Tips for effective Circles Project monitoring and evaluation
results.a: Document all the problems experienced by the user, and also the solutions provided. Documentation is highly important for evaluation.

results.q: How do I fill in the interview forms?
results.a:
Conduct a one-on-one face-to-face interview with the research participants 

Ask one question to the participant, and wait for their answer before moving on to the next question 

Select/type the answer according to the response from the respondent for each question 

Fill in the form on the spot when you are with the research participants to ensure that you enter the answers correctly according to the responses 

Bring printed questions from the google form, paper and pen for areas with a weak signal (in case the google form doesn't work but you still want to collect the answers)

results.q: When should I use the Circles Research Participant Sign Up form?
results.a:
The Circles Research Participant Sign Up form should be used when you are recruiting people that agree to commit to being participants of the Circles Indonesia Research Project. You need to conduct a face-to-face interview and input the data on the form according to the answers given by the participants.  




Open https://www.circlesubi.id/ 

Go to the LOGIN menu on the top navigation bar 

Enter the password that has been given to you to access the page 

Go to the Monitoring menu on the top navigation bar

Look for the form or type "Circles Research Participant Sign Up Form" in the search box 

Click the "Bahasa Indonesia" button to access the form in Bahasa Indonesia 

Start the interview, and input the data on the form 

Once the form is submitted. Click "submit another response" to collect the data of another participant that you are recruiting
